dataset.independent_ground_truth: CISA SSVC Decision Rubric (Act=3, Attend=2, Track=1, Defer=0)

metrics.ndcg_at_10: Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain at K=10 using standard formula sum((2^rel - 1) / log2(i+2)) normalized by IDCG@10.
metrics.precision_at_10: Fraction of top 10 ranked items meeting relevance threshold (threshold=3 for Act/Emergency; threshold=2 for Actionable).
metrics.recall_at_10: Fraction of total relevant items retrieved in top 10.
metrics.spearman: Spearman Rank Correlation Coefficient between predicted ranking and reference priority order.
